## Additional Canvas Design templates

- `generated-phase-control` — `generated.phase-control-definition`, `replace`

## Phase view label registration

Resolve the winning `generated-phase-control` definition before opening Designer.
This preset changes only the Plan phase's artifact viewer button text. The
generated canvas still uses the host-owned view action and the selected phase adapter.
